finding: Gold option position is concentrated at A/B and anti-aligned with the answerer's letter preference after filtering.
cause: scripts/research/mine_moments.py asks the generator for options and answer_index without shuffling (its JSON example uses answer_index 0); verify_moments.py --drop-prior then removes questions the model answers without evidence, which it does more often when the gold sits at its preferred positions (C/D).
consequence: Absolute accuracies on the MIT set are distorted; paired selector comparisons on identical questions remain valid but noisier. Debiased numbers: reports/v2_circular/.
